steps.message: How many snow boarding activities did I do this week in the OpenTracks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.

Execute: adb shell "date; echo '---'; pm list packages | grep -i opentracks; echo '---'; ls -d /data/user/0/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -d /data/data/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -R /sdcard/Android/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i opentracks | head -n 20"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; echo '---'; pm list packages | grep -i opentracks; echo '---'; ls -d /data/user/0/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -d /data/data/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -R /sdcard/Android/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i opentracks | head -n 20""
python android_env.py adb "adb shell "ls -l /data/user/0/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases; echo '---'; ls -l /data/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null""
